---
title: "Fall 2023"
date: "2023-11-15"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

responses <- read_csv("nwssmm_biannual_newsletter_fall_2023.csv")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
categories <- c(
  "From the Chapter Leaders", "Introducing...",
  "Research Update", "Fieldwork Update",
  "Publication", "Research Blooper",
  "Small Victory", "Photo"
)

for (category in categories) {
  
  if (hasName(responses, category)) {
    
    dfx = responses |>
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(category)))
    
    if (nrow(dfx) == 0) {
      next
    }
    
    cat(glue("# {category}"))
    cat("\n")
    
    for (i in 1:length(dfx[[category]])) {
      
      if (hasName(dfx, glue("{category} - Title"))) {
        
        up_title = dfx[[glue("{category} - Title")]][i]
        cat(glue("## {up_title}"))
        cat("\n")
      }
      
      up_author = dfx$Name[i]
      up_email = dfx$Email[i]
      update = dfx[[category]][i]
      
      if (category == "Photo") {
      
        up_photo_file = dfx[[category]][i]
        up_photo_caption = dfx[["Photo Caption"]][i]
        
        cat("\n\n")
        cat(glue("![](../{up_photo_file})"))
        cat("\n\n")
        cat(glue("<i>{up_author} ({up_email})</i>"))
        cat("\n\n")
        cat(up_photo_caption)
        cat("\n\n")
        cat("******")
          
      } else {
      
        cat("\n\n")
        cat(glue("<i>{up_author} ({up_email})</i>"))
        cat("\n\n")
        cat(update)
        cat("\n\n")
      }
      
      if (category == "Publication") {
        up_link = dfx[["Publication Link"]][i]
        cat(glue("Publication available at this link: {up_link}"))
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```
